note: Events stand for well-formed records; `verifies` says whether the record passes check 1; `crl_dates` are the CRL dates of the usable CRLs whose tree has the record's root (one root can belong to several CRLs; empty means none). `date` repeats the date in `challenge`. Two scopes appear only to test independence; a real roster accepts the scopes listed for it. `current` null means none.
